dialogue.translation: Ndewo, mụ Ada. Biko, nyere okwu n'okpuru okwukwe.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Hi Ana, this is Luis. Please call me back soon.
dialogue.translation: Ndewo Ada, mụ Luis. Biko, kpọ m nso.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Okay, Luis. What is your number?
dialogue.translation: Mma, Luis. Gị nọmba ole?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It is 555-1234. Thank you!
dialogue.translation: Ọ bụ 555-1234. Daalụ!

scenario: At the post office sending a package
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

vocabulary.note: Verbụ ndoro: send - sent - sent
Ndoro nke 'parcel'
Ezigara ndoro dịka ụzọ ma ọ bụ ndoro ịgbalịa
Ezigara ndoro ịdị n'ihi ma ọ bụ ndoro ịtụle
Pronoun nke ọ bụla
N'oge a, 'have' na-egosi na ọ bụ verbụ ndoro nke na-egosi ụbọchị ndoro
Ezigara ndoro ịdị n'okpuru ma ọ bụ ndoro ịgbalịa

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I want to send this package to my friend.
dialogue.translation: Achọrọ m ịzụ akwụkwọ ọrịa a na enyi m.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: We have it at the counter. Please fill out this form for the package.
dialogue.translation: Anyị nwere ya na counter. Biko zụta akwụ ụgwọ a n'ihi akwụkwọ ọrịa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Is this all for the package?
dialogue.translation: A na-egosi na ọbara ndụmọdụ a n'ihi akwụkwọ ọrịa?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, we have all we need. You can send it now.
dialogue.translation: Ee, anyị nwere ọbara ndụmọdụ anyị chọrọ. Ị nwere ike ịzụ ya ugbu a.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thank you.
dialogue.translation: Daalụ.

scenario: Describing your daily routine
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

vocabulary.note: Ọnụrụ asụsụ nke na-egosi 'ịzụta n'ime ụlọ'.
Ọnụrụ asụsụ nke na-egosi 'nke ndị a na-eme n'ime 6 na 12.
Ọnụrụ asụsụ nke na-egosi 'ịtụle ndị a'.
Ọnụrụ asụsụ nke na-egosi 'azịza mbụ n'ụbọchị'.
Ọnụrụ asụsụ nke na-egosi 'ịchị' bụ ọrụ, a na-emeghị ka ọ bụrụ ngwa.
Ọnụrụ asụsụ nke na-egosi 'n'ụlọ' bụ na-eme n'ime 'n'ụlọ'.
Ọnụrụ asụsụ nke na-egosi 'mgbede' bụ n'ime 6 na 10.
Ọnụrụ asụsụ nke na-egosi 'chọọ' ma ọ bụ 'hụ' n'ime ndị a na-egosi 'nke ndị a na-eme n'ime nkwenye'.
Ọnụrụ asụsụ nke na-egosi 'n'ihi na'.
Ọnụrụ asụsụ nke na-egosi 'ịrị' bụ ọrụ ọhụrụ: ịrị, ịrịrị, ịrịrị.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I get up at seven in the morning.
dialogue.translation: M rịụta n'ihi na asaa n'ụtụtụ.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Then I have breakfast and go to work.
dialogue.translation: N'ihi na m na-azịza ma m ga-achị.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I work at home in the evening.
dialogue.translation: M na-achị n'ụlọ n'oge mgbede.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I watch TV because I like it.
dialogue.translation: M hụ TV n'ihi na m emeri ya.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Then I sleep at ten.
dialogue.translation: N'ihi na m ga-eri n'ihi na iri.

scenario: Asking about opening hours
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

vocabulary.note: Ọ bụ okwu dị ka ị na-egosi na ụlọ ahịa dị n'ime ndoro ndoro.
Ọ na-egosi ihe mere, n'ihi a na-eme n'ụbọchị ugbu a.
N'ime agha a, ọ bụrụ na ọ na-egosi ugwo nke ụbọchị.
Ọ na-egosi ndụmụ ugwu nke izu.
Ọ na-egosi ugwo nke ugbu a.
Ọ na-egosi ike ọzọ ma ọ bụ ike ịnwe.
Ọ na-egwuregwa ndụmụ ugwu nke izu.
Ọ na-egosi nke ọ bụla nke ụbọchị.
Ọ na-egosi ihe dị iche iche.
Ọ na-egwuregwa ugwo nke ụbọchị.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Can you tell me the open time today?
dialogue.translation: Ọ dị mfe ịmụta m ugwo nke ụlọ ahịa n'ụbọchị ugbu a?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: We open at nine, but we close at five.
dialogue.translation: Anyị na-ebipụta na ọnwa asaa, mana anyị na-egosi na ọnwa ise.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: And on Saturday, until what time are you open?
dialogue.translation: Na izu mbosara, ọ bụrụ na anyị na-ebipụta ruo ugwo ole?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: On Saturday, we close at one.
dialogue.translation: N'izu mbosara, anyị na-egosi na ọnwa otu.

scenario: Choosing a dish from a menu
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

vocabulary.note: Ọ bụrụ na ndoro ndoro nke ị nwere ike.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: What do you like to eat?
dialogue.translation: Gịnị ka ị nwere ike iri?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I like fish or chicken with rice.
dialogue.translation: A nwere ike iri azụ ma ọkụkọ na osikapa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: The fish is very good here.
dialogue.translation: Azụ a nwere ike ukwuu nke ọma ebe a.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Then I try some fish, please.
dialogue.translation: Ọ bụrụ na a tụlee oke azụ, biko.

key_phrases.translation: Gịnị ka ị nwere ike iri?

key_phrases.phrase: The fish is very good here.
key_phrases.translation: Azụ a nwere ike ukwuu nke ọma ebe a.

scenario: At the bank for a simple transaction
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

vocabulary.note: Nke a na-egosi nke a na-egosi nke a na-egosi nke a na-egosi nke a na-egosi nke a
Ọ bụkwa ndepụta ('ọtụtụ ego') ma ọ bụ adịverbi ('ọtụtụ nke ukwuu').
Ọ na-eme ka mkpuruokwu a ga-eme nke ukwuu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I need money now.
dialogue.translation: A chọrọ ego n'oge a.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Here is your card. Go there with your ID.
dialogue.translation: N'ahịa bụ kaadi gị. Gba n'ọnụ na-akwụ ụkpụrụ gị.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Will you give me more cash?
dialogue.translation: Ga-emere m ọtụtụ ego?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, I will give you the money now. Go there.
dialogue.translation: Ee, m ga-emere gị ego n'oge a. Gba n'ọnụ.
